package.name: multi_robot_bridge
package.description: Cross-domain relay that forwards ArUco-based drone-relative pose detections from the Tello's ROS 2 graph (cyclonedds, domain 10) to ASTRO's ROS 2 graph (rmw_zenoh_cpp, ASTRO domain), and publishes the drone's pose as a TF transform in ASTRO's map frame.
